summary: iOS Fabric proof screen checks an actual protected route (GET /v1/client/agents?limit=1) for an unpaired client instead of the public capabilities read.

replay.detail: No daemon, store or projection code changed; the merge touches only the iOS app's Fabric proof screen, a new helper and its test.

schema.detail: No database schema, claim or persisted-format change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No protocol, route or gateway behavior changed. The proof screen's own check now requires a 401 or 403 carrying the st3.client error envelope from a protected route, because pairing discovery is public; it affects only that test screen.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption; app-side test tooling only.

manual.detail: No operator action. A test gateway whose protected route does not refuse an unpaired client now fails the proof, which is the intended check.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to restore the previous proof; no durable state is written.
